title: "World Map Distorted by Fertility Rate"
output: html_document
runtime: shiny

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(shiny)
library(dplyr)
library(readr)
library(sf)
library(plotly)
```

## Loading Cleaned Data

Please run the Implementation.Rmd file (in the `implementation` folder) before this file.
It creates the cleaned data that this file reads from the `output-data` folder, which is
one level up from this `UI_run` folder.

```{r load}
# The cleaned files are in output-data, one folder up from this file.
# (If R is running from the main project folder instead, look for output-data there.)
output_dir <- "../output-data"
if (!dir.exists(output_dir)) output_dir <- "output-data"

needed <- c("cartograms.rds", "tfr_clean.csv")
if (!all(file.exists(file.path(output_dir, needed)))) {
  stop("The cleaned files are missing from ", output_dir,
       ". Run Implementation.Rmd first; it creates them.")
}

cartograms <- readRDS(file.path(output_dir, "cartograms.rds"))
tfr        <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "tfr_clean.csv"), show_col_types = FALSE)

years       <- sort(unique(tfr$Year))
countries   <- sort(unique(tfr$Country))
map_types   <- c("Contiguous", "Non-contiguous", "Dorling circles")

# The same map window for every year and every type, so the map does not jump when the year or
# the type changes. It is the size of the contiguous map plus a small margin. (A few shapes of the
# non-contiguous map are bigger than the window in some years, and are cut at its edge.)
b <- st_bbox(cartograms[cartograms$Type == "Contiguous", ])
pad_x <- 0.03 * (b[["xmax"]] - b[["xmin"]])
pad_y <- 0.03 * (b[["ymax"]] - b[["ymin"]])
map_window <- lapply(setNames(map_types, map_types), function(t) {
  list(x = c(b[["xmin"]] - pad_x, b[["xmax"]] + pad_x), y = c(b[["ymin"]] - pad_y, b[["ymax"]] + pad_y))
})

# One table per type and year, so that showing a map is a simple lookup and not a search of all rows
carto_list <- split(cartograms, paste(cartograms$Type, cartograms$Year, sep = "|"))
rm(cartograms)
```

```{r classes}
# Fixed classes are used for every year, so that colors mean the same thing in 1950 and in 2026.
class_breaks <- c(0, 1.5, 2.1, 3, 4.5, 6, Inf)
class_labels <- c("Below 1.5", "1.5 to 2.1 (below replacement)", "2.1 to 3.0",
                  "3.0 to 4.5", "4.5 to 6.0", "6.0 and above")
no_data_label <- "No data"

class_colors <- c("#e5f5e0", "#c7e9c0", "#74c476", "#31a354", "#006d2c", "#00441b")
names(class_colors) <- class_labels
class_colors <- c(class_colors, setNames("#fff7a8", no_data_label))

tfr_class <- function(x) {
  out <- as.character(cut(x, breaks = class_breaks, labels = class_labels, right = FALSE))
  out[is.na(x)] <- no_data_label
  out
}
```

```{r ui}
ui <- fluidPage(
  navbarPage("World Map Distorted by Fertility Rate", selected = "Map",
    tabPanel("About",
      fluidRow(column(8, offset = 2,
        h3("About this map"),
        p("This map shows the world, distorted by fertility rate: each country is resized so that its
           area is proportional to its land area multiplied by its total fertility rate. Countries with
           high fertility look bigger and countries with low fertility look smaller."),
        tags$ul(
          tags$li("Use the year slider to see how the world changes between 1950 and 2026."),
          tags$li("Choose the type of distortion: contiguous (countries stay connected), non-contiguous
                   (countries keep their shape and resize in place) or Dorling circles."),
          tags$li("The map changes only when you press Update map, because drawing a map takes a moment.
                   You can change the year and the type as many times as you like before pressing it."),
          tags$li("Click on a country, or choose it in the Country menu, to see its fertility rate and its
                   history."),
          tags$li("Countries in yellow have no data in this data set. They are drawn with the median
                   fertility rate of that year so that the map stays connected."),
          tags$li("Values the UN file labels as \"Projection\" (all values from 2024 on, and some earlier
                   ones) are marked as such.")
        ),
        h4("Source"),
        p("United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division.
           World Population Prospects 2024: Total fertility rate (both sexes, median variant),
           downloaded from the UN Data Portal."),
        p("The classes are the same in every year. The replacement level, about 2.1 births per woman,
           is the limit between the second and the third class.")
      ))
    ),
    tabPanel("Map",
      sidebarLayout(position = "left",
        sidebarPanel(width = 3,
          # The map is only redrawn when the button is pressed, and the button is switched off
          # while a map is being drawn, so that clicks cannot pile up.
          tags$style("html.shiny-busy #update_map { pointer-events: none; opacity: 0.5; }"),
          sliderInput("year", "Year", min = min(years), max = max(years),
                      value = 2023, step = 1, sep = ""),
          radioButtons("map_type", "Type of distortion", choices = map_types,
                       selected = "Contiguous"),
          actionButton("update_map", "Update map", class = "btn-primary", width = "100%"),
          uiOutput("map_status"),
          tags$hr(),
          selectInput("country", "Country (or click it on the map)",
                      choices = c("None" = "", countries), selected = ""),
          tags$hr(),
          tags$b("Total fertility rate"),
          tags$div(style = "font-size: 12px; color: #555;", "(births per woman)"),
          uiOutput("legend")
        ),
        mainPanel(width = 9,
          plotlyOutput("map", height = "520px"),
          tags$hr(),
          fluidRow(
            column(4, uiOutput("country_info")),
            column(8, plotlyOutput("country_plot", height = "260px"))
          )
        )
      )
    )

  )
)
```

```{r server}
server <- function(input, output, session) {

  # The year and type that are on the map now. They only change when Update map is pressed
  # (and once when the app opens). Nothing else redraws the map.
  applied <- eventReactive(input$update_map, {
    list(year = input$year, type = input$map_type)
  }, ignoreNULL = FALSE)

  output$map_status <- renderUI({
    a <- applied()
    changed <- input$year != a$year || input$map_type != a$type
    tags$div(style = "font-size: 12px; margin-top: 6px;",
      tags$div(style = "color: #555;", paste0("Showing: ", a$year, ", ", tolower(a$type))),
      if (changed) tags$div(style = "color: #b45f06;", "Settings changed. Press Update map."))
  })

  # Map data for the year and type that are on the map
  map_data <- reactive({
    a <- applied()
    d <- carto_list[[paste(a$type, a$year, sep = "|")]]
    d$Class <- factor(tfr_class(d$TFR), levels = names(class_colors))
    d$Hover <- ifelse(
      d$NoData,
      paste0("<b>", d$Country, "</b><br>No data"),
      paste0("<b>", d$Country, "</b><br>Fertility rate: ", sprintf("%.2f", d$TFR),
             "<br>", d$Class,
             ifelse(d$EstimateMethod == "Projection", "<br><i>UN projection</i>", ""))
    )
    d
  })

  # The black outline of the chosen country, as a line trace (the shape's coordinates, with a gap
  # between rings). It is added to, or removed from, the map that is already drawn.
  outline_trace <- function(d, country) {
    if (!nzchar(country)) return(NULL)
    sel <- d[d$Country == country, ]
    if (nrow(sel) == 0 || all(st_is_empty(sel))) return(NULL)
    m   <- st_coordinates(st_geometry(sel)[[1]])
    grp <- do.call(paste, as.data.frame(m[, setdiff(colnames(m), c("X", "Y")), drop = FALSE]))
    pieces <- split(as.data.frame(m[, c("X", "Y")]), factor(grp, unique(grp)))
    list(x = unlist(lapply(pieces, function(p) c(p$X, NA)), use.names = FALSE),
         y = unlist(lapply(pieces, function(p) c(p$Y, NA)), use.names = FALSE),
         type = "scatter", mode = "lines", hoverinfo = "skip", showlegend = FALSE,
         line = list(color = "black", width = 2.5))
  }

  state <- new.env()      # n_base: number of country traces; overlay: is an outline on the map?
  state$n_base  <- 0
  state$overlay <- FALSE

  output$map <- renderPlotly({
    d   <- map_data()
    win <- map_window[[applied()$type]]

    p <- plot_ly(source = "map") %>%
      add_sf(data = d, split = ~Country, color = ~Class, colors = class_colors,
             stroke = I("#6b7b6e"), span = I(0.5),
             text = ~Hover, hoverinfo = "text", hoveron = "fills",
             showlegend = FALSE) %>%
      layout(
        xaxis = list(visible = FALSE, range = win$x, fixedrange = FALSE),
        yaxis = list(visible = FALSE, range = win$y, scaleanchor = "x"),
        margin = list(l = 0, r = 0, t = 0, b = 0),
        dragmode = "pan"
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = TRUE, scrollZoom = TRUE, displaylogo = FALSE,
             modeBarButtonsToRemove = c("select2d", "lasso2d", "toImage"))

    # Remember which country each trace is, so that a click can be matched to a country.
    # (A trace is named "country<br />class".) This is done before the outline is added.
    built <- plotly_build(p)
    trace_country <<- vapply(built$x$data, function(tr) {
      parts <- strsplit(if (is.null(tr$name)) "" else tr$name, "<br />", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]
      hit <- parts[parts %in% countries]
      if (length(hit) > 0) hit[1] else NA_character_
    }, character(1))
    state$n_base  <- length(built$x$data)
    state$overlay <- FALSE

    # Outline the chosen country. isolate(): choosing another country must not redraw the map.
    tr <- outline_trace(d, isolate(input$country))
    if (!is.null(tr)) {
      p <- do.call(add_trace, c(list(p), tr))
      state$overlay <- TRUE
    }
    event_register(p, "plotly_click")
  })

  # Choosing or clicking a country only moves the outline on the map that is already drawn
  observeEvent(input$country, ignoreInit = TRUE, {
    proxy <- plotlyProxy("map", session)
    if (state$overlay) plotlyProxyInvoke(proxy, "deleteTraces", list(as.integer(state$n_base)))
    state$overlay <- FALSE
    tr <- outline_trace(map_data(), input$country)
    if (!is.null(tr)) {
      plotlyProxyInvoke(proxy, "addTraces", tr)
      state$overlay <- TRUE
    }
  })

  # Clicking a country on the map selects it (curveNumber starts at 0)
  trace_country <- character(0)
  observeEvent(event_data("plotly_click", source = "map"), {
    ev <- event_data("plotly_click", source = "map")
    clicked <- trace_country[ev$curveNumber + 1]
    if (length(clicked) == 1 && !is.na(clicked) && clicked %in% countries) {
      updateSelectInput(session, "country", selected = clicked)
    }
  })

  # Legend
  output$legend <- renderUI({
    tags$div(lapply(rev(names(class_colors)), function(lbl) {
      tags$div(style = "display: flex; align-items: center; margin: 3px 0; font-size: 13px;",
        tags$span(style = paste0("display: inline-block; width: 22px; height: 14px; margin-right: 8px; ",
                                 "border: 1px solid #999; background: ", class_colors[[lbl]], ";")),
        lbl)
    }))
  })

  # Country details
  country_row <- reactive({
    req(nzchar(input$country))
    tfr %>% filter(Country == input$country, Year == applied()$year)
  })

  output$country_info <- renderUI({
    if (!nzchar(input$country)) {
      return(tags$p(style = "color: #666;", "Click on a country on the map, or choose one in the Country menu."))
    }
    r <- country_row()
    shown_year <- applied()$year       # the year on the map, not the slider
    if (nrow(r) == 0) {
      return(tagList(h4(input$country), p("No data for this country in ", shown_year, ".")))
    }
    year_all <- tfr %>% filter(Year == shown_year)
    rank_n   <- sum(year_all$TFR > r$TFR) + 1
    tagList(
      h4(input$country),
      tags$p(tags$b("Year: "), shown_year),
      tags$p(tags$b("Total fertility rate: "), sprintf("%.2f", r$TFR), " births per woman"),
      tags$p(tags$b("Class: "), tfr_class(r$TFR)),
      tags$p(tags$b("Rank: "), rank_n, " of ", nrow(year_all), " countries (1 = highest)"),
      tags$p(tags$b("Type of value: "), r$EstimateMethod)
    )
  })

  output$country_plot <- renderPlotly({
    req(nzchar(input$country))
    h <- tfr %>% filter(Country == input$country)
    req(nrow(h) > 0)
    plot_ly(h, x = ~Year, y = ~TFR, type = "scatter", mode = "lines",
            line = list(color = "#31a354", width = 3),
            hovertemplate = "%{x}: %{y:.2f}<extra></extra>") %>%
      layout(
        title = list(text = paste("Fertility rate in", input$country), font = list(size = 14)),
        xaxis = list(title = ""),
        yaxis = list(title = "Births per woman", rangemode = "tozero"),
        shapes = list(
          list(type = "line", x0 = min(years), x1 = max(years), y0 = 2.1, y1 = 2.1,
               line = list(color = "grey", dash = "dot", width = 1)),
          list(type = "line", x0 = applied()$year, x1 = applied()$year, y0 = 0, y1 = 1, yref = "paper",
               line = list(color = "black", width = 1))
        ),
        annotations = list(list(x = max(years), y = 2.1, text = "Replacement level (2.1)",
                                showarrow = FALSE, xanchor = "right", yanchor = "bottom",
                                font = list(size = 10, color = "grey"))),
        margin = list(t = 40)
      ) %>%
      config(displayModeBar = FALSE)
  })
}

shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server, options = list(height = 1050))
```
